newsitem.title: USA: Zing sets June 17 as spinoff record date.
newsitem.headline: Zing sets June 17 as spinoff record date.

text.p: Zing Technologies Inc said Monday its board has set June 17 as the record date for the spinoff of its subsidiary, Transitional Analysis Component Technology Inc, in which it holds a 90 percent stake.
Zing, a semiconductors maker, said its board has also decided to raise its stake in Omnirel Corp to 100 percent, from 84 percent currently, and will issue common shares to buy out minority interests.
The Omnirel reorganization will take place immediately before the spinoff and will result in a pre-tax charge for the fourth quarter ending June 1997 estimated at between $1-$1.5 million, it said.
It said the expense represents compensation paid to Omnirel employees in exchange for their stock options.
To be renamed Omnirel LLC, the company will become its sole operating subsidiary after the reorganization, it said.
